method: Historical comparison fields were collected read-only using gh API/run logs, exact HTTP byte ranges of retained ZIP reports, and fixed before/after Prometheus snapshots. No historical run was rerun. The three separately planned candidate dispatches are recorded under candidate_validation.
limitations: Hot latency full-run histograms include warmup; qualification verdict is governed by sustained breach semantics, not this full-run histogram alone.
Before/after counter deltas use each run own retained measurement snapshots; the failed workload closed early, so run durations and populations differ.
Host I/O summaries describe shared GitHub-hosted runner observations; differences support I/O sensitivity but do not establish I/O as the sole cause.
All node services share one host; host-node-1 holds complete physical-device evidence while other host aliases report unavailable.
10/12 run passed despite 4.579% full-run hot samples above 400ms because report did not terminate under the sustained-breach gate.

candidate_validation.policy: Three independent sequential qualifications of one unchanged candidate; no failed-run retry or omitted outcome.
candidate_validation.latency_population: Full final report including warmup; not the sustained-breach qualification algorithm.
candidate_validation.correctness_scope: Reported counters and sampled delivery correlation, not exhaustive fanout verification.

storage_comparison.method: Each run retained before/after deltas; third run terminated early so durations differ. Host I/O maxima are interval observations, not exclusive root-cause proof. All three runs same candidate SHA93031a3bf.
limitations: Each run uses its own before/after Prometheus deltas. The failure terminated early, so means/fractions are more directly comparable than raw totals.
Host I/O summary has one available host-node-1 row; host-node-2, host-node-3 and host-load are unavailable. Do not present those as independent host observations.
Stage metrics preserve result labels. Compare result=ok with result=ok; failure additionally has result=err samples.
Histograms use count minus the le=0.1 bucket for durations strictly above 100ms.
These observations support storage/append latency amplification in the third run, not an exclusive causal diagnosis of host hardware.

metrics_cut_diagnosis.observed_drain_queues: All nodes have zero queue depth and inflight in first/last drain and final cuts.
metrics_cut_diagnosis.reproduction: 64/64 concurrent successful-observation scrapes disagreed across commit histogram counts before the metrics repair.
metrics_cut_diagnosis.limitation: Rejected hosted cut bodies were deleted; reproduction does not establish their exact mismatched families.
